full_name: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia -- Estimaciones Comunales de Pobreza (SAE) en base a la Encuesta Casen

codes: Porcentaje de personas en situación de pobreza por ingresos 2022
features.definition: Estimated share of the comuna's population below Chile's official income poverty line, 2022 -- Small Area Estimation (Fay-Herriot model, combining the Casen 2022 survey's direct estimate with a synthetic regression estimate) published by the Observatorio Social, Subsecretaria de Evaluacion Social, Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia. Covers 335 of Chile's 346 comunas (those with a Casen sample); comuna 'Puchuncavi' was excluded from the Fay-Herriot model as a documented outlier (see Resultados_Estimaciones_SAE_2022.pdf).

codes: Porcentaje de personas en situación de pobreza multidimensional 2022
features.definition: Estimated share of the comuna's population in multidimensional poverty (education, health, housing, employment/social security indicators combined, not just income), 2022 -- same Fay-Herriot SAE methodology as povertyRate, published by the same source. Covers 335 of Chile's 346 comunas.
